UPPSC LT Grade Assistant Teacher Final Result 2026 – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the Final Result for the post of Assistant Teacher (TGT). This recruitment was released for 7466 posts. Applications for the UP LT Grade Assistant Teacher Mains Recruitment 2026 were accepted from April 02, 2026, to April 17, 2026. The written examination was held on 13 June 2026 and 11 July 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UP LT Grade Assistant Teacher Final Result 2026 from the link given below.

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 125/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
